t2.thesis: Severe downward earnings revisions, a poor earnings reaction history, and acute regulatory overhang from the Texas gubernatorial election on data center buildouts outweigh high short interest squeeze potential.
reasons: IREN has won only 1 of its last 4 earnings reactions (25% hit rate), frequently selling off even on EPS beats.
Current-quarter consensus EPS estimates have been slashed from -0.235 to -0.665 over the past 90 days (-1.83 revision ratio).
Fresh political headlines regarding a Democratic sweep and Texas governor-elect pushing a data center moratorium directly target IREN's core Childress and Sweetwater expansion pipeline.
While 24.1% short interest and deeply washed-out technicals (-47% over 1 month) offer squeeze potential, management is unlikely to dispel near-term regulatory uncertainties on the print.
t2.deciding_variable: Management's Q1 revenue ramp commentary from Horizon 1 delivery and reassurance regarding Horizon 2-4 timelines amidst Texas moratorium concerns.

prior.from: ai_infra cluster (55.8%) and AMC base rate (53.8%) blend

t2.moved_from_prior: Moved down 7 percentage points from the 0.54 prior due to poor earnings track record, aggressive downward estimate revisions, and heavy sector-specific regulatory headwinds in Texas.

theses.expected: Stock drops further as execution costs, heavy net losses, and cautious commentary on Texas permitting disappoint investors.
theses.mechanism: Deepening operational losses combined with unmitigated regulatory risk cause institutional de-risking post-print.
theses.wrong_if: Management reports strong contracted ARR conversion from Microsoft and guides confidently through Texas political rhetoric.

theses.expected: Stock stages an oversold relief bounce driven by short covering.
theses.mechanism: With 24% short interest and stock down 24% in 5 days, even meeting low expectations triggers rapid buy-to-cover flows.
theses.wrong_if: Horizon 2-4 delivery timelines are pushed back into 2027, triggering analyst downgrades.

theses.expected: Muted reaction within the wide implied move (16.7%).
theses.mechanism: AI Cloud ARR expansion is offset by continuing drag and impairments from retiring Bitcoin mining hardware.
theses.wrong_if: A major new hyperscaler cloud contract or non-dilutive financing milestone is announced.

key_observations: Reported Q1 AI Cloud Services revenue vs. prior quarter's $70.5M
Updates on Microsoft Horizon 2-4 delivery and commissioning progress in Childress, Texas
Operating cash burn, capex guidance, and commentary addressing Texas data center regulatory risks
Contracted ARR progression relative to the $4B targeted for 2026 capacity
